passive.name: Silver Stake
passive.description: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

Q.name: Ritual Nails
Q.description: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

W.name: Soul Ignition
W.description: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the d…

E.name: Ashen Pursuit
E.description: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

R.name: Purgatory
R.description: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.
